object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: No test compares the offered tools with the table. Read the table rows from the committed object file MELLON-MCP-SRS/objects/MELLON-MCP-SRS-34.xml, start mellon-mcp over stdio and call list_tools. For each row, find the tool and parameter in its inputSchema. Expected: they exist; the type matches (string, integer, boolean, array of strings, object of strings; 'or null' is anyOf with null; 'one of' is an enum); the parameter is in required exactly when the row says yes; the schema default equals the row's default; a tool row '(none)' has no properties. A one-off comparison on 2026-11-11 found all 35 rows matched the development build.
